changes.text: Personal Data Processing Personal Data Processing shall mean various actions (operations) with personal data, including collection, systematization, clarification (updating, changing), use of personal data, including: automated processing of personal data meaning processing of personal data using computer technologies; storage and accumulation of personal data meaning actions resulting in storage and accumulation of personal data for the purpose of creating the Database on the Company's servers located in the territory of the Russian Federation; destruction of personal data meaning actions resulting in an impossibility to restore the content of personal data in the Database and/or in a destruction of material carriers of personal data; distribution of personal data meaning actions aimed at disclosure of personal data made publicly available by the User.
The volume and content of the processed personal data shall be regulated by the legislation of the Russian Federation and shall comply with the declared processing purposes.
The purpose of processing the User’s personal data is to create the CVs and Vacancies Database.
The Company shall not have the right to process the User’s personal data concerning his/her political, religious or other beliefs, or private life.
When transmitting the User’s personal data, the Company shall warn the persons receiving the User’s personal data that such data can be used only for the purposes for which they are communicated.
This rule shall not apply to the exchange of Users' personal data in the manner prescribed by federal laws.
Protection of the User’s personal data from unlawful use or loss shall be ensured by the Company at its own expense in the manner prescribed by the legislation of the Russian Federation.

The User shall have the right, at any time and at his/her discretion, to withdraw his/her consent to the processing of his/her personal data by the Company by independently deleting any specific or all of his/her CVs posted in the Database.
To do this, the User may use the appropriate technical functionality in the Database.

If the User withdraws his/her consent to the processing of his/her personal data, the Company shall terminate their processing or ensure termination of such processing (if personal data are processed by another person acting on behalf of the operator) and, if personal data are no longer required, destroy such personal data or ensure their destruction (if personal data are processed by another person acting on behalf of the Company) within a period not exceeding three days from the date of receving such withdrawal.
Access to Personal Data Provision of access to the Applicant's CV.
Access to personal data contained in the Applicant's CV is possible only after registration in the Database as an Employer.
After registration, each Employer receives a unique login and password for a personal account in the Database which ensures access to Applicants' CVs.
Procedure for and methods of access provision.

If the Applicant's CV is displayed in a particular folder in the "Responses" section in the personal account in the Database, this shall mean that access to the relevant personal data has been transferred.

There are several ways to add Applicants' CVs to this section: sent by Applicants in response to a vacancy; received within a subscription (if the Employer has enabled this option when placing a vacancy); found independently in the Database.
In case of the Basic Tariff, the CV is automatically added after purchasing the Applicant's contact details.

In case of the Maximum Tariff, the Applicant's contact details are already available to the Employer, and the CV is added to the "Responses" section only if the Employer takes any actions with it ("invite"/"under consideration", etc.) or clicks the "Add to Inbox" link.
If the Employer's registration provides for multi-user access, the CVs may be additionally added to the "Responses" section as follows: if received from a colleague; if copied from a colleague.

Ongoing Requirements for Personal Data Protection The Company shall take legal, organizational, and technical measures (or ensure such measures) which are necessary and sufficient to ensure fulfillment of the obligations stipulated by the legislation on personal data protection and regulatory acts adopted in accordance therewith for the purpose of protecting personal data from unlawful or accidental access, destruction, blocking, distribution, depersonalization of personal data, or other illegal actions in relation to personal data.

The measures specified in Clause 5.1 of the Regulation, including their content and the choice of personal data protection means, shall be determined by, and internal regulatory documents on processing and protection of personal data shall be approved (issued) by the Company based on the requirements of regulatory acts of the Russian Federation on personal data processing and protection.
The Company shall eliminate any identified violations of the legislation on personal data processing and protection.

Personal data shall be stored in a form that enables to determine the personal data subject within a time period not exceeding the period required for the purposes of personal data processing, if the storage period is not established by the federal law, or a contract to which the personal data subject is a beneficiary or guarantor.
The term for posting the User’s personal data in the form of a CV is unlimited and shall be determined independently by the User.

In particular, the Company shall: assess the efficiency of the measures taken and implemented to ensure personal data security; account for machine carriers of personal data and ensure their safety; detect unauthorized access to personal data and take appropriate measures; recover personal data modified or destroyed due to unauthorized access; establish rules for access to the personal data being processed; organize a security regime for the premises in which machine personal data carriers are located impeding the possibility of uncontrolled entry or stay in such premises of any persons who do not have the right of access to such premises.

Responsibility of the Parties The Company, as a legal entity, shall bear administrative responsibility for any violation of the procedure for collection, storage, use, or dissemination of personal data in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.

The User hereby unconditionally agrees and acknowledges that: by placing his/her personal data in the form of a CV in the Database, he/she makes them available to an unlimited number of people, i.e., makes them publicly available.

The Company shall not be responsible for maintaining their confidentiality and/or use by any third parties; The Operator provides Database Customers and Anonymous Database Customers with access to the Applicant's CVs.

The Company shall not be liable for any possible misuse of Users's personal data that has occurred due to: technical malfunctions in software, servers, or computer networks that are beyond the Company's control; interruptions in the database operation caused by intentional or unintentional use of the database by any third parties for purposes other than intended ones; transfer of the User’s registration data or any information, including the User's CV as a whole or its individual parts or data, by the User from the Database to other persons who are not registered users of the Database or to other users who do not have access to such information due to registration conditions or contracts concluded with the Company.
Final Provisions The Company provides access to the Regulation using the corresponding information and telecommunication network.

Any amendments or supplements to this Regulation shall be introduced by order of the Company's General Director, and thereafter they are subject to publication in the public domain on the website [LINK]
